content.text: The image makes this very clear. Looking directly at the California Driver License card on p.10, the DL field shows **O7314062** — the first character is clearly a letter **O** (printed in the same red font as the other alphanumeric characters on the license), not a digit zero. The OCR system misread it as `07314062` (digit zero), but the actual printed value is `O7314062`, which matches both the MVR report on p.9 and the driver schedule.
